derivation: from G2596 (κατά) and a derivative of the same as G4195 (Πόντος);

occurrences.text: But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me.
But whoso shall offend one of these little ones which believe in me, it were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and that he were drowned in the depth of the sea.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
